game_title: Strip And Replace – Icefall Ladder Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Icefall Ladder, ladders up an icefall: the avalanche scout must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Icefall Ladder: ladders up an icefall
core_gameplay_loop: In Icefall Ladder, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round, crevasse ghouls strike the flag pole, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the flag pole from crevasse ghouls in Icefall Ladder: keep the clean_text meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: clean_text drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 6 (applied tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Icefall Ladder.
